own_source_interpretation: Exactly CH1/CH2; DMA base 0x40020000; channel bases 0x40020020 and 0x40020040; independent DMACH1 IRQ9 and DMACH2 IRQ10; IRQ11 reserved.
Own UM p135 establishes ICR reset/no-op 0xFFFFFFFF and four R1W0 fields TC1/TE1/TC2/TE2 at bits0/1/4/5.

Own UM p287 explicitly establishes byte SRAM-to-TDR BLOCK, REPEAT1, source increment, fixed destination, channel EN before DMATX and TC before closing DMATX. Wire completion separately requires TXBUSY0.
Current Rev1.3 datasheet and own UM establish exact 8 KiB SRAM at0x20000000 for C6/K6/F6; generic metadata has no SRAM and retains safe admission/staging rejection.
F6 UART1 has only PA14 for TX and remains excluded from safe TxPin. C6/K6 examples use UART1 PA8 AF2 + UART2 PA2 AF2; F6 examples use UART2 PA6 AF2 + UART3 PA2 AF1.
TE, STATUS2 stop request, EN clear and request closure provide no error-time bus-drain proof. Permanent owner retention is an explicit runtime obligation; source review does not prove liveness.

native_helper_review.review_note: Existing scalar setters only alter the selected bit. Appended helper returns all ones, so other channel bits/reserved bits retain ones. Runtime clear_flags reads no ICR value, starts from write_noop, applies only its selected channel setters, then write_value. Full runtime review remains separate.
